name: Payment Return Reason 8
definition: Provides further details on the reason of the return of the transaction.

OriginalBankTransactionCode.name: Original Bank Transaction Code
OriginalBankTransactionCode.definition: Bank transaction code included in the original entry for the transaction.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Specifies the reason for the return.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further details on the return reason.

ReturnReasonRule.definition: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AdditionalInformation must be present.
